rule: final_reserved entries are numerically sealed: access.py refuses to open them unless the active reservation sets allow_final_numeric_access (it is false). source_selection RX must be excluded from every encoder gradient, scaler, statistic and epoch choice of the encoder evaluated on them.

wisig.fold_provenance: RETRAIN_ROOT/configs/receiver_p2/wisig_folds.json (registered 2026-10-23, before any calibration result); not two independent captures, not hardware-family-held-out (14 source RX = 6 B210, 7 N210, 1 X310)
wisig.development_date_note: date index 2 has been read in earlier development pipelines; it is NOT a blind test

shen.outer_group_note: both groups were used repeatedly in P0-P2E development: paired mechanism evidence, never a first blind test
shen.source_selection_rule: first two RX of each group in registered order; each task holds ONE of them out and fits the other four; fixed before any calibration score
shen.epoch_selection_partition: last 40 rows per TX of the FIT RX only
shen.development_note: not cached locally; access history must be audited before they are built (DATASET_READINESS.md)
shen.stress_unregistered: dated/location files under Test/ and the drift set: not registered; access history unaudited

blocks.rule: blocks are fixed raw sample ranges chosen before any window is extracted; windows never cross a block edge; the 5% gaps are discarded

use.source_rx: fit block -> registration statistics of the 25 new identities (n_src per class recorded)
use.target_rx: support block -> m-shot support draws; query block -> fixed query; target fit block unused

front_end.provenance: configs/shen_p2a8/g1_registration.json osu_periodic_coherence_min / osu_minimum_windows_per_class; applied inside each block, never tuned on targets

osu.note: single physical RX per direction: K is not identifiable inside OSU; only the TRANSFER_POOLED_PRIOR variant (Shen-fitted K_pool, Sigma_pool in a frozen Shen trunk) is defined
